requirements.title: Feature flag OFF preserves KH-02 behavior with zero Amazon network calls
Unauthorized/policy-blocked path blocks browser navigation with BLOCKED_POLICY
Official Playwright MCP handshake and unavailable client classification
Approved Amazon.com product URLs parse true ASIN; unsafe/SSRF/wrong host rejected
ASIN discrepancy among URL, canonical link, and structured metadata rejects identity
Variation child ASIN vs parent ASIN preserved and canonical identity deduplicated
Unrelated 10-char tokens, category/search URLs, sponsored items, affiliate junk rejected
Bot wall, CAPTCHA, login, 403, 429, malformed response, timeout, empty data classified honestly
Product-specific exact match requires corroboration beyond brand name
Bounded 1-3 product-specific approved attempts (<=4 operations/run)
Budget concurrency=1, no 5th operation, max 2 attempts/op, rolling rate gate
Abort/cancel during navigation closes owned session/process and blocks stale worker writes
SQLite unique composite key and idempotent retry prevent duplicate evidence rows
Workspaces A and B fully isolated across DB, API, and UI
Legacy run JSON without marketplaceEvidence remains readable and UI unchanged
REAL_PROVIDER_VERIFIED requires live authorized response + invocation + hashes + same run; fixtures rejected
Upstream providerRequestId remains null when absent; local providerInvocationRef separate
Evidence hash matches canonical observed payload and rejects fabricated summary
GET endpoints do not mutate DB rows or SHA-256 table digests (including 200/403/404)
3-way parity (SQLite -> HTTP GET -> Chromium DOM) for persisted Amazon evidence
Amazon listing observation has ZERO effect on G15 60d demand and G16 live ad/merchant gate
Absent price != 0; review count/BSR != verified sales, conversion, or winning score
Source selection and live/cache modes do not cross-contaminate; disabled provider not counted live
Input sanitization strips untrusted HTML/JSON-LD prompt injection and script tags
Rejected records preserved with rejection reason, timestamp, and run lineage but excluded from positive counts
REAL_PROVIDER_VERIFIED pilot gate passes only if 3 live authorized US identities observed; otherwise BLOCKED_POLICY
Historical DEV/HOLDOUT replay excludes post-cutoff Amazon observations with strict as-of integrity
Existing Product Finder UI filters, tabs, drawer, and worker polling unregressed
Full regression, integration, Next build, and Chromium run from exact frozen CODE_SHA
Independent validator catches and rejects >=20 adversarial mutants
